globalContext.description: A small commerce application used to demonstrate change-impact analysis.

businessTerminology.order total: The final payable order amount after pricing, discount, and tax rules.
businessTerminology.checkout: The process that calculates and confirms the final order.

businessRules: Checkout depends on the final order total.
Invoice calculation uses pricing and tax.

src/pricing.ts#calculatePrice.purpose: Calculates base price from unit price and quantity

src/discount.ts#applyDiscount.purpose: Applies a percentage discount to an amount

src/tax.ts#addTax.purpose: Adds tax to a monetary amount

src/order.ts#buildOrderTotal.purpose: Builds the final discounted order total including tax

src/order.ts#generateInvoice.purpose: Calculates invoice pricing including tax without discount

src/checkout.ts#checkout.purpose: Calculates the final order amount and confirms the order
